title: Root Supervisor Tree (xmpp_sup)
description: Configure the root OTP supervisor using rest_for_one restart strategy with intensity 5 and period 10. Order child specs so xmpp_session_registry boots before xmpp_router to prevent stale ETS lookups.
verificationHint: Call xmpp_sup:start_link(), inspect child processes with supervisor:which_children(xmpp_sup), and verify both xmpp_session_registry and xmpp_router are running as supervised permanent workers.

title: Incremental XML Stream Framer (xmpp_stream_parser)
description: Implement binary packet framing over fragmented TCP streams. Handle <stream:stream>, <auth>, <iq>, <ping/>, and <message> stanzas while calling binary:copy/1 to unpin heap memory and prevent sub-binary retention leaks.
verificationHint: Feed partial chunks like <<"<stream:st">> followed by <<"ream to='localhost'>">>. Verify the parser emits [{stream_open, <<"localhost">>}] with an empty leftover buffer.

title: Concurrent ETS Session Registry & Monitors (xmpp_session_registry)
description: Manage concurrent user sessions inside a high-throughput public ETS table with {read_concurrency, true}. Monitor C2S pids and automatically purge sessions upon receiving process 'DOWN' messages.
verificationHint: Register two sessions for the same bare JID with different priorities. Verify lookup_by_jid returns the highest-priority PID, and that killing that PID causes the monitor to fall back to the surviving session.

title: C2S Connection State Machine (xmpp_c2s_statem)
description: Build the client-to-server connection lifecycle as an OTP gen_statem using state_functions: wait_for_stream -> wait_for_sasl -> authenticated -> session_established, with active-once TCP flow control.
verificationHint: Step through stream opening, SASL PLAIN authentication, and IQ resource binding. Confirm transition to session_established and registration in xmpp_session_registry.

title: Stanza Router & Offline Store (xmpp_router)
description: Dispatch messages to online C2S processes via lookup_by_jid/1. If the recipient is offline, spool the stanza into the in-memory offline message store for retrieval on next login.
verificationHint: Route a message between two active C2S pids, then route to an unregistered user. Verify the offline message is queued and retrievable via pop_offline_messages/1.

title: Chaos Monkey Resilience & 5-Module Integration (xmpp_sup)
description: Subject the 5-module cluster to dynamic fault injection. Verify that killing xmpp_session_registry triggers rest_for_one supervisor cascades, safely terminating and restarting xmpp_router while preserving tree stability.
verificationHint: Boot xmpp_sup, inject an abnormal exit into xmpp_session_registry, and verify the supervisor restarts both registry and router with fresh PIDs.
